title: First cosimplicial identity for the face maps of the simplex category
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of the ordered sets $[m]=\{0<1<\dots<m\}$ and order-preserving maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq n$ let $\delta^n_i:[n-1]\to[n]$ be the increasing injection omitting $i$. Then for every $n\geq1$ and all $0\leq i<j\leq n+1$ one has $\delta^{n+1}_j\circ\delta^n_i=\delta^{n+1}_i\circ\delta^n_{j-1}:[n-1]\to[n+1]$.
